name: Starving for Love
source:
Upon falling deep into a cave, you must convince the only creature living there to like you enough to help you out.  But maybe don't make them like you too much.

[From [url=https://games-of-crimsin.itch.io/starving-for-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你掉进洞穴深处时，你必须说服住在那里的唯一生物足够喜欢你来帮助你。但也许不要让他们太喜欢你。

[来自[url=https://games-of-crimsin.itch.io/starving-for-love]itch.io[/url]]
